name: Pucallpa

queries.query: Pucallpa Peru official cadastral parcel map GIS Municipalidad Provincial de Coronel Portillo
queries.result: Found the official Municipalidad Provincial de Coronel Portillo organization page describing its Subgerencia de Catastro, official Plano Regulador/lote documents, and Peru's official IDEP geospatial-service catalog. No anonymous Pucallpa parcel geometry API was established.

queries.query: Pucallpa Perú catastro mapa catastral parcelas SIG Municipalidad Provincial de Coronel Portillo
queries.result: Resultados oficiales identificaron la Subgerencia de Catastro de la Municipalidad Provincial de Coronel Portillo, documentos del Plano Regulador de Pucallpa, el catálogo IDEP y servicios de INGEMMET; no se verificó una respuesta pública anónima de parcelas con identidad nativa y geometría.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official organization page assigns the Subgerencia de Catastro responsibility for organizing, updating and supervising provincial cadastral activities, including urban growth and habilitaciones urbanas. It does not expose a public parcel API.
Official 2022 ordinance references direct adjudication of lots under Pucallpa's Plano Regulador; this is documentary evidence, not a machine-readable parcel layer.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales del Perú (IDEP)
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: national catalog of public geospatial services
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Catalog documents WMS/WFS discovery, including public agency services, but no Pucallpa-specific parcel service was identified in this attempt.
Search result identifies a public ArcGIS layer named Zona Catastral with JSON/GeoJSON support; it is not evidence of urban land parcels in Pucallpa and was not retained as parcel geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: A local municipal cadastral custodian and national geospatial catalogs are evidenced; no anonymous citywide Pucallpa parcel geometry scope was verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed
blocker: No safe anonymous Pucallpa parcel response containing native identity and geometry was verified. Municipal evidence is documentary/custodial only; IDEP and INGEMMET routes did not yield a qualified urban parcel response, and TLS/timeout/oversized responses were not bypassed.
remainingUncertainty: The municipal cadastral base and Plano Regulador may exist in non-public or document-only systems. Route-specific errors and the absence of an exact-point hit were not used to infer citywide absence.
nextStep: Retry the official municipal/IDEP catalog routes and inspect only public geometry-plus-ID responses; independently qualify any actual Pucallpa parcel adapter before runtime admission.
